# SQLite amalgamation

This directory contains the SQLite 3.54.1 amalgamation from the official
SQLite download, consisting of `sqlite3.c`, `sqlite3.h`, and `sqlite3ext.h`.
The source archive was `sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip`.

The archive SHA3-256 is:

```text
92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30
```

SQLite is in the public domain. The upstream source and header files include
the SQLite blessing. The official download page is
<https://sqlite.org/download.html>.
